ItacAcademyItem.Name: Oziosi (Accademia degli)
ItacAcademyItem.EmblemDescription: An eagle surmounted by a crown and an angel
ItacAcademyItem.Notes:
Emblem from Academiae Ociosorum. Libri III, Naples, 1613. 
For a detailed account on the Oziosi Academy see Girolamo de Miranda, Una quiete operosa: forme e pratiche dell`Accademia napoletana degli Oziosi, 1611-1645. Naples, Federiciana Editrice Universitaria, 2000.
